method: Non-destructive CSS viewports. Regions are normalized x,y,width,height; source files remain unchanged.

cover.protect: All group faces, both end participants and event banners; crop ceiling and chair bottoms.

overview-meeting.protect: Full table width and participant faces; remove excess ceiling and foreground desk.

overview-team.protect: Both end participants, full blue banner and group; crop roof/sky only.

field-payment.protect: Full photo width and the interaction with elderly participants.

digital-launch.protect: All faces, event banners and both side participants.

finance-meeting.protect: Full table width, central speaker and participant faces.

insurance-service.protect: Staff and residents at the consultation table; crop ceiling and floor.

social-payment.protect: Staff and residents' faces across the full photo width.

portrait-dinh-hoang-minh.protect: Full hair, ears, face and upper chest.

portrait-phan-huu-linh.protect: Full hair, face and upper chest; remove excess waist/arms.

portrait-tran-thi-lam-thy.protect: Full hair, face and upper chest; remove ceiling, dining table and chair.

achievement-support.protect: Company name, donation banner and central participants; no amount altered.

achievement-team.protect: Full group width and full event banner.

achievement-lighting.protect: Both end participants, lighting banner, ribbon and Dong Thap watermark; crop only sky and outer screenshot border.

achievement-payment-detail.protect: Central staff/resident interaction and PVI shirt; no partial cut through the main subjects' heads.

achievement-meeting-detail.protect: Central speaker and surrounding discussion context.

achievement-insurance-detail.protect: Consultation staff, residents at the table and paperwork.
